title: Switch packages/ui's hand-authored ui-doc-mesh.meta.v1 file from JSON to YAML, so component example snippets no longer need to be written as escaped-quote strings
objective: Owner-directed: 'eu quero melhorar a forma de escrever uma documentacao' (I want to improve the way of writing documentation) -- the real pain point is packages/ui/documentation/mesh/ui-doc-mesh.meta.v1.json requiring JSX example snippets to be written as JSON strings with escaped quotes (e.g. "<Button label=\"Run\" />"), which is unpleasant to author and has no syntax highlighting. Owner chose YAML over a real-.tsx-example-file alternative (smaller, lower-risk change). YAML's block scalar syntax (|) lets the snippet be written as near-literal JSX with no escaping. Only the hand-authored input format changes -- packages/ui/scripts/export-doc-mesh.mjs's generated output (docs/generated/meshes/ui-doc-mesh.v1.json) stays JSON, since that is consumed programmatically (by architecture-studio's generate-stories.mjs and the gallery import), not hand-read.
validations: DONE: js-yaml 4.1.0 added (MIT, well-established release -- deliberately not the just-published 5.2.3, which triggered this repo's minimumReleaseAge supply-chain gate and got auto-excepted by pnpm without owner review; that exception was reverted and the version pinned down instead).
DONE: ui-doc-mesh.meta.v1.json converted to an equivalent ui-doc-mesh.meta.v1.yaml (same data, YAML block-scalar snippets, no escaping); old .json meta file deleted.

DONE: export-doc-mesh.mjs updated to parse the .yaml meta file via js-yaml's load(); each example's snippet is trimmed (YAML block scalars keep one trailing newline) before being written to the generated JSON.
DONE: project.json's docs-mesh-export target inputs updated to the .yaml path; README.md's reference updated.

DONE: full pipeline re-verified end to end: export-doc-mesh.mjs runs clean and produces correct multi-line-JSX snippets, apps/architecture-studio's generate-stories.mjs regenerates all 7 stories correctly (verified the multi-line DataTable snippet renders as valid JSX), Storybook dev server restarted and confirmed serving all stories via its own index.json, packages/ui's own tsc/tests(9)/api-check all still pass.
artifacts: pnpm-workspace.yaml (reverted an auto-added, unreviewed release-age exception)
risks: Pure format change to a hand-authored input file plus the one script that reads it -- the generated JSON output schema and every downstream consumer are unaffected.
